a2-06-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Hotel?
a2-06-01.scenario: On the way back from Ninh Bình, Daniela asks you which of the two hotels was better value. The first hotel was cheaper.
a2-06-01.prompt: Tell Daniela that this hotel is cheaper than the other one.
cues: Say it costs less than the other
a2-06-01.target: Este hotel es más barato que el otro.
a2-06-01.english: This hotel is cheaper than the other one.
a2-06-01.canDo: I can compare two trips or places using más, menos and tan.

a2-06-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Beaches and Cities
a2-06-02.scenario: Lauren asks you whether you find the beaches or the cities of the trip quieter. For you the beaches are quieter.
a2-06-02.prompt: Tell Lauren that the beaches are quieter than the cities.
a2-06-02.target: Las playas son más tranquilas que las ciudades.
a2-06-02.english: The beaches are quieter than the cities.
a2-06-02.canDo: I can compare places and experiences using comparative adjectives with correct agreement.

a2-06-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Long Journey
a2-06-03.scenario: On the train to Hanoi, Kaylee asks you how this trip has been. It has been longer than your previous trip.
a2-06-03.prompt: Tell Kaylee that this trip has been longer than the previous one.
cues: Compare its length with the previous trip
a2-06-03.target: Este viaje ha sido más largo que el anterior.
a2-06-03.english: This trip has been longer than the previous one.
a2-06-03.canDo: I can compare recent experiences using comparative structures with the pretérito perfecto.

a2-06-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Class or Walk?
a2-06-04.scenario: Carlos asks you whether you prefer the cooking class or the walk. You prefer the class because it was more fun.
a2-06-04.prompt: Tell Carlos which you prefer and why, comparing the class with the walk.
cues: Say why it is more fun
a2-06-04.target: Prefiero la clase de cocina; es más divertida que el paseo.
a2-06-04.english: I prefer the cooking class; it is more fun than the walk.
a2-06-04.canDo: I can compare places and memories using comparative expressions with travel and opinion vocabulary.

a2-06-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Better Trip
a2-06-05.scenario: On the train back to Hanoi, Daniela asks you how this year's trip compares with last year's and which activity you liked best. You have travelled more this year, and the boat trip was more interesting than the excursion.
a2-06-05.prompt: Tell Daniela that this year you have travelled more than last year and that the boat trip has been more interesting than the excursion.
cues: Compare this year with last year
Compare the boat trip with the excursion
a2-06-05.target: Este año he viajado más que el año pasado. El paseo en barco ha sido más interesante que la excursión.
a2-06-05.english: This year I have travelled more than last year. The boat trip has been more interesting than the excursion.
a2-06-05.canDo: I can talk about recent trips, places and memories using the pretérito perfecto and comparisons.

a2-06-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Special Trips
a2-06-consolidation.scenario: On the train to Hanoi, Carlos asks you how this trip compares with the previous one. It has been just as special, but the return has been less comfortable than the trip.
a2-06-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos that this trip has been as special as the previous one and that the return has been less comfortable than the trip.
cues: Say the two trips are equally special
Compare the return with the trip
a2-06-consolidation.target: Este viaje ha sido tan especial como el anterior. El regreso ha sido menos cómodo que el viaje.
a2-06-consolidation.english: This trip has been as special as the previous one. The return has been less comfortable than the trip.
a2-06-consolidation.canDo: I can compare recent trips, places and memories.
